##  {background-color="#1A2744"}

```{=html}
<h2 style="color:var(--light);font-size:2.67em;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.01em;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 0.4em">Motivation: Real Data is Messy</h2>
```

```{r}
#| label: metadata-table
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
library(readr)
library(DT)

metadata <- read_csv("data/metadata.csv")

meta_na <- metadata
meta_na[] <- lapply(meta_na, function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | trimws(x) == ""] <- "NA"
  x
})
tech_col  <- "Technician Name"
seq_depth <- "Sequencing Depth (M)"

datatable(
  meta_na,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 8,
    lengthMenu = c(8, 16, 32, 64),
    scrollX    = TRUE,
    scrollY    = "250px",
    dom        = "frtip"
  ),
  class = "compact stripe"
) |>
  formatStyle(columns = names(meta_na), color = styleEqual("NA", "red")) |>
  formatStyle(columns = tech_col, color = styleEqual(c("alice", "BOB", "NA"), c("red", "red", "red"))) |> 
  formatStyle(columns = seq_depth, color = styleInterval(0, c('red', '')))
```

```{r}
)
```

## Reading Excel Files with readxl {background-color="#F7F9FC"}

::: section-label
Section 2 — Excel import
:::

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
library(readxl)  # install separately — not part of core tidyverse

# List all sheets first
excel_sheets("my_experiment.xlsx")

# Read a specific sheet
df <- read_xlsx("my_experiment.xlsx", sheet = "Sample Info")

# Skip merged header rows, supply your own column names
df <- read_xlsx("my_experiment.xlsx", sheet = "counts",
                 skip = 3,
                 col_names = c("gene", "A1", "A2", "B1", "B2"))

# Read a specific cell range
df <- read_xlsx("my_experiment.xlsx", range = "B4:F20")
```

```{=html}
<div class="card card-orange" style="border-left:4px solid var(--orange);padding:10px 16px;margin-top:8px">
  <p style="color:#744210;margin:0;font-size:0.95em"><strong>readxl is read-only.</strong> To write .xlsx use <code>writexl::write_xlsx()</code> or <code>openxlsx::write.xlsx()</code>.</p>
</div>
```

## Same Code, Two Styles {background-color="#F7F9FC"}

:::::: columns
::: {.column width="47%"}
**Nested — read inside-out**

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
arrange(
  select(
    filter(
      penguins,
      species == "Adelie"
    ),
    species, bill_length_mm
  ),
  bill_length_mm
)
```

```{=html}
<div class="card card-red" style="border-left:4px solid var(--red);padding:10px 16px;margin-top:8px">
  <p style="color:#9B2335;margin:0;font-size:0.95em">Count the parentheses. Find where to add the next step.</p>
</div>
```
:::

::: {.column width="6%"}
<p style="font-size:2.5em;color:#CBD5E0;margin:0.2em 0;text-align:center">

→

</p>
:::

::: {.column width="47%"}
**Piped — read left to right**

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
penguins |>
  filter(
    species == "Adelie"
  ) |>
  select(
    species, bill_length_mm
  ) |>
  arrange(bill_length_mm)
```

```{=html}
<div class="card card-green" style="border-left:4px solid var(--green);padding:10px 16px;margin-top:8px">
  <p style="color:#276749;margin:0;font-size:0.95em">Add a step? Append another <code>|&gt;</code> line. Always reads like a recipe.</p>
</div>
```

```{=html}
    <div class="verb-card" style="border-top:4px solid var(--yellow)"><p class="mono" style="color:#F6E05E;font-size:1.15em;margin:0 0 4px">arrange()</p><p style="font-size:1.0em;color:var(--light);font-weight:600;margin:0 0 4px">Sort rows by column values</p><p class="smaller muted mono" style="margin:0;line-height:1.5">bill_length_mm<br>desc(body_mass_g)</p></div>
    <div class="verb-card" style="border-top:4px solid var(--orange)"><p class="mono" style="color:#F6AD55;font-size:1.15em;margin:0 0 4px">group_by()</p><p style="font-size:1.0em;color:var(--light);font-weight:600;margin:0 0 4px">Split into invisible groups</p><p class="smaller muted mono" style="margin:0;line-height:1.5">species<br>species, island</p></div>
    <div class="verb-card" style="border-top:4px solid var(--red)"><p class="mono" style="color:#FC8181;font-size:1.15em;margin:0 0 4px">summarise()</p><p style="font-size:1.0em;color:var(--light);font-weight:600;margin:0 0 4px">Collapse each group to one row</p><p class="smaller muted mono" style="margin:0;line-height:1.5">n(), mean(), sum()<br>min(), max(), sd()</p></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## filter() and select() {background-color="#F7F9FC"}

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
**`filter()` — keep rows**

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
penguins |>
  filter(
    species == "Adelie",
    !is.na(body_mass_g),
    body_mass_g >= 3500
  )
```

```{=html}
<div class="card card-blue" style="border-left:4px solid var(--blue);padding:10px 16px;margin-top:8px">
  <p style="color:#2B6CB0;margin:0;font-size:0.95em"><strong>Logical operators:</strong> <code>==</code> <code>!=</code> <code>&gt;=</code> <code>&gt;</code> <code>&amp;</code> <code>|</code> <code>!is.na()</code> <code>%in%</code></p>
</div>
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
**`select()` — keep columns**

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
penguins |>
  select(
    species, island,
    starts_with("bill")
  )

penguins |>
  select(-year, -sex)
```

```{=html}
<div class="card card-purple" style="border-left:4px solid var(--purple);padding:10px 16px;margin-top:8px">
  <p style="color:#553C9A;margin:0;font-size:0.95em"><strong>Select helpers:</strong> <code>starts_with()</code> <code>ends_with()</code> <code>contains()</code> <code>where(is.numeric)</code></p>
</div>
```
:::
:::::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## mutate(), group_by(), summarise() {background-color="#F7F9FC"}

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
**`mutate()` — add / change columns**

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
penguins |>
  mutate(
    mass_kg = body_mass_g / 1000,
    size_class = case_when(
      body_mass_g >= 4500 ~ "large",
      body_mass_g >= 3500 ~ "medium",
      .default = "small"
    )
  )
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
**`group_by()` + `summarise()`**

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
penguins |>
  filter(!is.na(body_mass_g)) |>
  group_by(species, sex) |>
  summarise(
    n         = n(),
    mean_mass = mean(body_mass_g),
    sd_mass   = sd(body_mass_g),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )
```

```{=html}
<div class="card card-orange" style="border-left:4px solid var(--orange);padding:10px 16px;margin-top:8px">
  <p style="color:#744210;margin:0;font-size:0.95em">Always add <strong><code>.groups = "drop"</code></strong> to avoid surprises in later steps.</p>
</div>
```
:::
:::::

## Building a Full Pipeline {background-color="#F7F9FC"}

Filter Chinstrap penguins → compute bill ratio → rank by size

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
penguins |>               # start with the data
  filter(
    species == "Chinstrap",  # 1. keep one species
    !is.na(bill_length_mm),  #    drop NAs
    !is.na(body_mass_g)
  ) |>
  select(island,           # 2. keep useful cols
    bill_length_mm,
    bill_depth_mm,
    body_mass_g) |>
  mutate(                  # 3. create new column
    bill_ratio = bill_length_mm / bill_depth_mm
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(body_mass_g))  # 4. sort heaviest first
```

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
```{=html}
<div class="card card-green" style="border-left:4px solid var(--green);padding:10px 16px">
  <p style="color:#276749;margin:0;font-size:0.95em"><strong>Each step is one verb</strong> — add a step → new <code>|&gt;</code> line; remove a step → delete that line.</p>
</div>
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
```{=html}
<div class="card card-blue" style="border-left:4px solid var(--blue);padding:10px 16px">
  <p style="color:#2B6CB0;margin:0;font-size:0.95em"><strong>No intermediate objects</strong> — nothing stored until you assign. Memory stays clean.</p>
</div>
```
:::
:::::

## pivot_longer() and pivot_wider() {background-color="#F7F9FC"}

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
**`pivot_longer()` — wide → long**

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
counts |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = ctrl_1:trt_2,
    names_to  = "sample",
    values_to = "count"
  )
```

```{=html}
<div class="card card-blue" style="border-left:4px solid var(--blue);padding:10px 16px;margin-top:8px">
  <p style="color:#2B6CB0;margin:0;font-size:0.95em">Use <code>cols = starts_with("ctrl")</code> or <code>-gene</code> to select columns flexibly.</p>
</div>
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
**`pivot_wider()` — long → wide**

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
long_counts |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = sample,
    values_from = count
  )
```

```{=html}
<div class="card card-purple" style="border-left:4px solid var(--purple);padding:10px 16px;margin-top:8px">
  <p style="color:#553C9A;margin:0;font-size:0.95em">Useful for summary tables, matrices for export, or wide format a collaborator expects.</p>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="card card-red" style="border-left:4px solid var(--red);padding:10px 16px;margin-top:8px">
  <p style="color:#9B2335;margin:0;font-size:0.95em">Also useful: <strong><code>separate()</code></strong> splits one column into two — e.g. <code>"ctrl_1"</code> → <code>"ctrl"</code> and <code>"1"</code>.</p>
</div>
```
:::

## Clean a Sample Sheet {background-color="#1A2744"}

::: section-label
Section 5 — Pair Coding Exercise
:::

**Data**

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
 
sample_sheet <- tribble(
  ~SampleID, ~Treatment,  ~Replicate, ~RIN, ~Reads_M, ~Technician,  ~Platform,
  "S01",     "control",   1,          8.2,  42.1,     "jsmith",     "Illumina",
  "S02",     "control",   2,          7.9,  38.4,     "J. Smith",   "Illumina",
  "S03",     "treated",   1,          8.5,  51.2,     "jsmith",     "Illumina",
  "S04",     "treated",   2,          NA,   29.8,     "mlee",       "PacBio",
  "S05",     "treated",   3,          7.1,  35.0,     "M. Lee",     "PacBio",
  "S06",     "control",   3,          6.8,  44.7,     "mlee",       "Illumina"
)
 
datatable(
  sample_sheet,
  options = list(
    dom        = "t",
    pageLength = nrow(sample_sheet),
    autoWidth  = FALSE,
    scrollX = FALSE,
    initComplete = JS(
      "function(settings, json) {",
      "  $(this.api().table().node()).closest('.dataTables_wrapper').css('font-size','0.72em');",
      "}"
    )
  ),
  class  = "compact stripe",
  width  = "100%"
)
```

## Data Wrangling Challenges {background-color="#F7F9FC"}

Pick your spice level. Use **sample_sheet** (mild/medium) or **penguins** (hot).

<br>

:::::: columns
::: {.column width="33%"}
```{=html}
<div class="card card-blue" style="border-left:4px solid var(--blue);padding:10px 16px">
  <p style="color:#2B6CB0;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 6px;font-size:1.0em">Mild</p>
  <ul style="color:var(--black);margin:0;padding-left:16px;font-size:0.9em;line-height:1.7">
    <li>Standardise technician names: all `jsmith`/`J. Smith` → `"J. Smith"`, all `mlee`/`M. Lee` → `"M. Lee"`</li>
    <li>Remove samples where RIN is NA</li>
    <li>Add a column `passes_qc` that is `TRUE` when `Reads_M >= 35</li>
    <li>Sort by `Reads_M` descending</li>
  </ul>
</div>
```
:::

::: {.column width="33%"}
```{=html}
<div class="card card-green" style="border-left:4px solid var(--green);padding:10px 16px">
  <p style="color:#276749;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 6px;font-size:1.0em">Medium</p>
  <ul style="color:var(--black);margin:0;padding-left:16px;font-size:0.9em;line-height:1.7">
    <li>Add a `cost` column: `Reads_M * 100 </li>
    <li>Group by `Technician` and `Platform`. </li>
    <li>Compute: number of samples, total reads, total cost. </li>
  </ul>
</div>
```
:::

::: {.column width="34%"}
```{=html}
<div class="card card-orange" style="border-left:4px solid var(--orange);padding:10px 16px">
  <p style="color:#744210;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 6px;font-size:1.0em">Hot</p>
  <ul style="color:var(--black);margin:0;padding-left:16px;font-size:0.9em;line-height:1.7">
    <li>Pivot the Medium summary wide so each Platform is its own column of `total_cost`.</li>
    <li>Fill missing combinations with `0`</li>
    <li>Add a column `over_budget = TRUE` when total Illumina cost exceeds $4,000. </li>
    <li> Export your summary with <code>write_csv()</code></li>
  </ul>
</div>
```
:::
